name: Render Scale
description: Adds 0.5x and 0.75x sub-native 3D render scale options for low-end devices (plus 1x / 1.5x / 2x overrides) across both WebGPU and WebGL.

settings.label: 3D render scale
settings.description: Sub-native 0.5x / 0.75x cuts GPU fill-rate on low-end devices while keeping HUD overlays crisp. Auto restores Biketerra's native setting.
